title: 🏥 Fort Lee Healthcare: Multiple RN Jobs in ED & ICU - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Healthcare in Fort Lee, NJ is busy and hiring, especially for experienced RNs in high-acuity settings. If you’ve done ICU or ED work, there are some strong options here.
Registered Nurse (RN) – Emergency Department Employer: Fairview Hospital / Cleveland Clinic Location: Fort Lee, NJ Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed ED role focused on fast, patient-centered care and leading the care team. You’ll do full assessments, create and update care plans, handle meds and equipment, and support patients and families in crisis moments.
Registered Nurse (RN) – Emergency Department – $63/hr Employer: Health Marketing Location: Fort Lee, NJ Type: Full-time Salary: $63/hour ED RN position with Level I trauma experience preferred. Good fit if you like high-intensity work and want clear hourly pay, with a focus on documentation, safety, and quality improvement.
